scope: Ordinary paragraph, H1-H9 and quote depth rendering plus mobile layout controls and flat Tab/Shift+Tab commands; not full universal indentation certification.

upstream.range_rules: First target cannot exceed previous sibling depth + 1; any selected block at >=8 rejects increasing the whole range. First zero depth rejects outdent; later zero-depth blocks stay zero. Old over-cap data is not clipped.

cause: ParagraphStyle already preserved desktop props.depth, but ordinary text builders did not use it for layout; mobile indentation controls only dispatched list commands. Standard AppFlowy Tab would use nested block structure rather than the desktop flat depth field.
implemented: Shared paragraph presentation adds depth * 32 to left padding for paragraphs, headings and quotes. Distributed alignment receives the resulting reduced layout constraints before measuring lines.
Mobile layout buttons and new high-priority Tab/Shift+Tab commands write depth-only stable-ID transactions, preserving text, heading, formatting, selection and independent undo boundaries.
Eight-level and previous-sibling guards prevent partial multi-target changes. Existing over-cap values remain visible and can be explicitly decreased.
Code Tab and table keyboard navigation are not intercepted. List layout commands retain their existing independent behavior.

targeted.command: flutter test --no-pub test/paragraph_indent_test.dart test/heading_typography_test.dart test/paragraph_style_native_test.dart --reporter expanded

validation.native_depth_case: Writes heading depth 7 -> 8 through real FRB applyBlockSnapshot, undo to 7, redo to 8, closes/reopens the same SQLite cache and verifies 8 persists. No Rust/FRB interface changes were required.
validation.history_case: Undo after remote reorder targets the original block and preserves new remote text and fs; reverse ranges are atomic, readonly/mixed code ranges do not write.

android_hardware.remaining_scenarios: Existing H1-H9 defaults, mixed paragraph/inline font overrides and links with real wrapping, and empty heading placeholders across five alignments.

android_hardware.test_data: Temporary local test paragraphs with fake initialized controller; no account login or online document access. Keyboard-height stream fixed at zero; this is layout verification, not real IME/hardware-keyboard interaction.

normal_app_restoration.data_preservation: --keep-app-running during integration and install -r during restoration; no uninstall or clear-data commands.

remaining_limits: Lists retain existing 0-6 indentation and existing list operations; 8-level generic list Tab is not completed.
Text/list mixed selections and cross-parent indentation are not supported by the new text command.
iOS, online desktop bidirectional/reconnect/persistent ACK and real external hardware-keyboard behavior were not verified.
